_comment: Time-boxed pip-audit exceptions consumed by scripts/security/security-audit.sh. Expired entries are NOT applied (finding becomes blocking). Register: .agent/WORKAROUND-REGISTER.md WR-SEC-1/2.

exceptions.reason: CVE-2026-81726: path traversal in model save/load APIs (TransitionParser, AveragedPerceptron, PerceptronTagger.save_to_json, save_maxent_params). Fix merged on nltk develop (pathsec_open, PR #3945 et al.) but unreleased; 3.10.3 is latest on PyPI. Exposure: aidb never imports nltk (transitive via llama-index-core, which requires nltk>=3.9.3) => vulnerable APIs not reachable. Remove this exception when nltk >3.10.3 releases.

CVE-2025-69872: pickle deserialization on cache read (needs cache-dir write access). diskcache is unmaintained (no release since 2023-08, OpenSSF Scorecard Maintained 0); upstream PRs #361/#364 unmerged. Resolution: replaced in nixos-docs by stdlib sqlite3 TextTTLCache (branch fix/nixos-docs-diskcache-no-pickle). Bridge only: remove this exception as soon as that branch merges (diskcache then leaves requirements and the Nix env).
